dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: #Hello there, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: There was a familiar scent upon the wind. I guessed that you would come.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm... I'm very happy to have someplace to settle down for a time.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: When I'm by myself, I often look outside just to appreciate the scenery.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: With no one around, one's heart will naturally calm.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Tomorrow is uncertain, but at least I'll always have the stability of the present.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: A pity that I can't reside here for long, for my blade will dull.

choices.text: You can come here for a rest whenever you want.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I am most thankful.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Each year yields scorching summers and frigid winters. The hottest and coldest days are difficult for me to weather.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: But the weather here is always comfortable...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: It is truly a blessing to leisurely pass one's time here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Alright... but what to talk about...? Let me think.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The rainy season recently set itself upon us. Any topics pertaining to rain?

choices.text: I always seem to run into heavy rain outside...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Hm, if the rain is heavy, I'll usually seek shelter.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Caves are my primary choice, but if there's a wild animal inside, you must first contest it.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: My second choice is an abandoned temple, but there are usually drafts and the omnipresent scent of mold.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: If there are no other options, I'll shelter under a tree.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: But I don't dare do this in a thunderstorm — too dangerous.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: As a last resort, I'll try my luck on houses with their lights on... Of course, I'll give up if I'm unlucky.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why is staying at someone's home your last choice?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: If someone with a blade knocks on the door during a rainy night, most people would be on their guard.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Understanding this, there's no need to bother them. Besides, the world is vast and there is always somewhere to go.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: No need for worry. The outdoors won't always be rainy, and one's life won't always be overcast.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Turn your gaze skyward on a clear night, and you will see thousands of stars.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm... please take this.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I heard that the maple leaves back home have already turned red. I want to go back and take a look, but it's a long journey. I can't return for now...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I was wandering the market the other day and saw these well-preserved maple leaves, so I bought some.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Although I can't confirm whether they're from my hometown, they still help blunt my homesickness.

choices.text: You're very fond of maple leaves, then?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Yes.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: In the past, I collected maple leaves upon the autumnal winds and carried them on my person.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: When I was on the boat, I scattered them across the surface of the ocean and watched them float to distant shores.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Perhaps another homesick soul will have picked up one of those leaves...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I also want to see your hometown.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Ah... How improper of me.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I should have taken the initiative to invite you... But I was absorbed by my own homesickness.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: ...Thank you.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Then take this maple leaf as a keepsake. Our promise is thus made.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: When the maple leaves next bloom red, we shall go to my hometown together.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Indeed... From a purely visual perspective, red maple leaves have a unique beauty to them.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Every year in my hometown, people enjoy the scene of falling red leaves.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: The maple leaves are a crimson sunset and fall like scarlet rain.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: A thick layer of fallen leaves on the ground, the chirping of autumn insects, and the wandering birds...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Kazuha.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Good morning... It feels like you're somehow different today.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You can talk to me about anything. Although I cannot guarantee anything else, I'm a very good listener.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Kazuha.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Tonight's wind is gentle, so there should be a plentitude of wonderful dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: A tranquil teahouse, with finely crafted ornamentation and the scent of tea lingering in the air...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Mm... The atmosphere here is truly delightful.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: When you can spare the time, why not join me to discuss our favorite poetry over tea?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: This peaceful scene puts the mind at ease.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Even the most ordinary stretch of countryside, the humblest of hills, harbors poignant profundities from the distant past.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Offer them your full, undivided attention, and each flower, each tree, each blade of grass will whisper their stories to you.
